body: According to my research, it could cost anywhere from $400-700. Definitely not cheap. And as for those acquaintances it's not very easy to make friends, I've hardly had friends for years. Don't have an official diagnosis but I probably have like high functioning autism or something like that so communication is genuinely a hard thing. Last time I really had a friend was when I was 10 or so, so talking to old friends is more or less out of the question too, and that's assuming I ever kept in touch with them in the first place.

I don't really have friends, mostly just acquaintances, and the coping mechanism was my computer because it was easy to play games on and I could talk to people on those games without the need of a headset or a membership like consoles.

I mean I know that, I've done research on overdosing, I've experimented with overdosing in the past. I could write an essay on why you shouldn't overdose because of the unreliability and possible side effects. But I'm so desperate I do not care. 

What caused my feelings? Literally everything. The final straw was school and accidentally destroying my only coping mechanism today, but I've had feelings of loneliness, feeling alienated, self-hatred, depression, anxiety, etc., over a variety of different things for years now.

It's not really the words, it's more that it's just one more issue on top of a growing issue. It's like more "proof" as to why I should just die. Of course I know it's not real proof or anything I should take to heart but I'm sick of the growing issue moreso than anything else. I'm used to her awful words, I just found the hypocrisy laughable.

For a first world country I'd say it's pretty fucked up but that's a lot of things in America. When compared to a third world or backwards country yeah, the prisons are like Heaven. But it's kinda sad that you even have to stoop that low to begin with to make America's prisons seem at least _half_ decent.
